# RFP ACT SACT 26-67

Request for Proposal for **Commercial-off-the Shelf (COTS) Event Management Software Platform**.

**Bid closing date**: Bids shall be received at HQ SACT, Purchasing and Contracting Office, no later than **~~17~~ 21  September 2026, 0900 hours**, Eastern Daylight Time, Norfolk, Virginia, USA. No bids shall be accepted after this date and time. No hard copy proposals will be accepted.

[**Click here to open RFP ACT SACT 26-67 Amendment #1**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/rfp026067_amdt1.pdf)

[**Pricing**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/rfp026067_pricing.xlsx) \| [**Questions & Answers #1**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/rfp026067_qa1.pdf) \| [**Questions & Answers #2**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/rfp026067_qa2.pdf)
